defects.cause: The browser-supplied account replaces the account bound to the reset token.
defects.trigger: A caller holding an unexpired Alice token submits account=Bob and a replacement hash.
defects.consequence: The caller changes another account login hash without its reset token.
defects.evidence: account = request.get('account', record['account']) selects an arbitrary existing account after validating only the token's expiry/use.
defects.proof: oracle.py creates two users and one Alice token; cross-account update succeeds on head and is refused without mutation on control. It also checks legitimate reset, expiry, and replay.

limitations: The hash value is an already-derived synthetic hash; password hashing algorithm strength and token entropy are outside this case.
